title: Louisbourg Lighthouse

buildingCutout.basis: Suppress the separately mapped 1923 lighthouse during the original tower’s date range.

terrainReference.basis: Unaltered HRDEM elevation on the present land approach near the original southwest doorway. Ground at other sides follows the headland’s current slope.

mapIdentity.provider: Archive plan FR CAOM 3DFC172B and OpenStreetMap ruin location

identities.name: Louisbourg Lighthouse
identities.address: Lighthouse Point, Louisbourg, Nova Scotia, Canada

mapIdentity.scope: The historic drawing gives the round plan, tapered outline, plinth and three stringcourses. Its plan is registered to the mapped first lighthouse ruins.

note: An archival section and elevation record the ashlar exterior, three projecting courses, small openings, framed doorway and heraldic plaque, slate roof and glazed timber lantern with a hooded vent. Parks Canada gives the height as 22.3 m.
